package domain

import (
	"strings"
	"time"
)

// DiagnosticAssessmentBootstrapRequestV1 is the intentionally tiny public
// bootstrap command. Course and onboarding selectors are authority-derived.
type DiagnosticAssessmentBootstrapRequestV1 struct {
	Schema                    string `json:"schema"`
	ExpectedOnboardingVersion int64  `json:"expected_onboarding_version"`
	ExpectedPreviousRevision  *int   `json:"expected_previous_revision,omitempty"`
}

type DiagnosticAssessmentBootstrapResultV1 struct {
	Schema            string    `json:"schema"`
	PlanID            string    `json:"plan_id"`
	AttemptID         string    `json:"attempt_id"`
	PlanRevision      int       `json:"plan_revision"`
	PlanDigest        string    `json:"plan_digest"`
	OnboardingVersion int64     `json:"onboarding_version"`
	CreatedAt         time.Time `json:"created_at"`
}

// DiagnosticBootstrapBinding is rollout-provisioned only. Active=false is an
// explicit tombstone: the newest revision always wins and fails closed.
type DiagnosticBootstrapBinding struct {
	GoalCode        string    `json:"goal_code"`
	DirectionCode   string    `json:"direction_code"`
	CourseID        string    `json:"course_id"`
	BindingRevision int64     `json:"binding_revision"`
	PolicyVersion   string    `json:"policy_version"`
	BindingDigest   string    `json:"binding_digest"`
	Active          bool      `json:"active"`
	CreatedAt       time.Time `json:"created_at"`
}

// DiagnosticBootstrapBindingDigest commits the whole append-only binding row,
// including an inactive tombstone and its effective timestamp.
func DiagnosticBootstrapBindingDigest(binding DiagnosticBootstrapBinding) (string, error) {
	return diagnosticJSONDigest(struct {
		Schema          string    `json:"schema"`
		GoalCode        string    `json:"goal_code"`
		DirectionCode   string    `json:"direction_code"`
		CourseID        string    `json:"course_id"`
		BindingRevision int64     `json:"binding_revision"`
		PolicyVersion   string    `json:"policy_version"`
		Active          bool      `json:"active"`
		CreatedAt       time.Time `json:"created_at"`
	}{"diagnostic-bootstrap-binding.v1", binding.GoalCode, binding.DirectionCode, binding.CourseID, binding.BindingRevision, binding.PolicyVersion, binding.Active, binding.CreatedAt.UTC()})
}

type DiagnosticBootstrapReceipt struct {
	StudentID              string    `json:"student_id"`
	IdempotencyKey         string    `json:"idempotency_key"`
	RequestHash            string    `json:"request_hash"`
	OnboardingVersion      int64     `json:"onboarding_version"`
	GoalCode               string    `json:"goal_code"`
	DirectionCode          string    `json:"direction_code"`
	CourseID               string    `json:"course_id"`
	BindingRevision        int64     `json:"binding_revision"`
	BindingDigest          string    `json:"binding_digest"`
	BindingCreatedAt       time.Time `json:"binding_created_at"`
	BootstrapContextDigest string    `json:"bootstrap_context_digest"`
	PlanID                 string    `json:"plan_id"`
	PlanRevision           int       `json:"plan_revision"`
	PlanDigest             string    `json:"plan_digest"`
	CreatedAt              time.Time `json:"created_at"`
}

func NormalizeDiagnosticBootstrapRequest(input DiagnosticAssessmentBootstrapRequestV1) (DiagnosticAssessmentBootstrapRequestV1, error) {
	if input.Schema != DiagnosticAssessmentBootstrapRequestSchemaV1 || input.ExpectedOnboardingVersion < 1 || (input.ExpectedPreviousRevision != nil && *input.ExpectedPreviousRevision < 1) {
		return DiagnosticAssessmentBootstrapRequestV1{}, ErrValidation
	}
	return input, nil
}

func NormalizeDiagnosticBootstrapBinding(input DiagnosticBootstrapBinding) (DiagnosticBootstrapBinding, error) {
	input.GoalCode = normalizeCode(input.GoalCode)
	input.DirectionCode = normalizeCode(input.DirectionCode)
	input.PolicyVersion = strings.TrimSpace(input.PolicyVersion)
	if input.GoalCode == "" || input.DirectionCode == "" || !canonicalUUID(input.CourseID) || input.BindingRevision < 1 || input.PolicyVersion != DiagnosticBootstrapPolicyV1 || !diagnosticDigest.MatchString(input.BindingDigest) || !canonicalUTCMicro(input.CreatedAt) {
		return DiagnosticBootstrapBinding{}, ErrValidation
	}
	digest, err := DiagnosticBootstrapBindingDigest(input)
	if err != nil || digest != input.BindingDigest {
		return DiagnosticBootstrapBinding{}, ErrValidation
	}
	return input, nil
}

func ValidateDiagnosticBootstrapReceipt(receipt DiagnosticBootstrapReceipt, record DiagnosticAssessmentPlanRecord) error {
	plan := record.Plan
	if ValidateDiagnosticPlan(plan) != nil || !canonicalUUID(receipt.StudentID) || receipt.StudentID != plan.StudentID || !canonicalUUID(receipt.IdempotencyKey) || receipt.IdempotencyKey != record.IdempotencyKey || !diagnosticDigest.MatchString(receipt.RequestHash) || receipt.RequestHash != record.RequestHash || receipt.OnboardingVersion != plan.OnboardingVersion || receipt.GoalCode != record.BindingGoalCode || receipt.DirectionCode != record.BindingDirectionCode || receipt.BindingRevision != record.BindingRevision || receipt.BindingRevision < 1 || receipt.BindingDigest != record.BindingDigest || !diagnosticDigest.MatchString(receipt.BindingDigest) || !canonicalUTCMicro(receipt.BindingCreatedAt) || !receipt.BindingCreatedAt.Equal(record.BindingCreatedAt) || receipt.CourseID != plan.CourseID || receipt.BootstrapContextDigest != plan.BootstrapContextDigest || receipt.PlanID != plan.ID || receipt.PlanRevision != plan.PlanRevision || receipt.PlanDigest != plan.PlanDigest || !canonicalUTCMicro(receipt.CreatedAt) || !receipt.CreatedAt.Equal(plan.CreatedAt) {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	binding, err := NormalizeDiagnosticBootstrapBinding(DiagnosticBootstrapBinding{GoalCode: record.BindingGoalCode, DirectionCode: record.BindingDirectionCode, CourseID: plan.CourseID, BindingRevision: record.BindingRevision, PolicyVersion: DiagnosticBootstrapPolicyV1, BindingDigest: record.BindingDigest, Active: true, CreatedAt: record.BindingCreatedAt})
	if err != nil || binding.GoalCode != record.BindingGoalCode || binding.DirectionCode != record.BindingDirectionCode {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	return nil
}

func ValidateDiagnosticPlanRecord(record DiagnosticAssessmentPlanRecord) error {
	if ValidateDiagnosticPlan(record.Plan) != nil || !canonicalUUID(record.IdempotencyKey) || !diagnosticDigest.MatchString(record.RequestHash) {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	binding, err := NormalizeDiagnosticBootstrapBinding(DiagnosticBootstrapBinding{GoalCode: record.BindingGoalCode, DirectionCode: record.BindingDirectionCode, CourseID: record.Plan.CourseID, BindingRevision: record.BindingRevision, PolicyVersion: DiagnosticBootstrapPolicyV1, BindingDigest: record.BindingDigest, Active: true, CreatedAt: record.BindingCreatedAt})
	if err != nil || binding.GoalCode != record.BindingGoalCode || binding.DirectionCode != record.BindingDirectionCode {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	return nil
}

func DiagnosticBootstrapRequestHash(studentID string, input DiagnosticAssessmentBootstrapRequestV1) (string, error) {
	if !canonicalUUID(studentID) {
		return "", ErrValidation
	}
	input, err := NormalizeDiagnosticBootstrapRequest(input)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	return diagnosticJSONDigest(struct {
		Schema                    string `json:"schema"`
		StudentID                 string `json:"student_id"`
		ExpectedOnboardingVersion int64  `json:"expected_onboarding_version"`
		ExpectedPreviousRevision  *int   `json:"expected_previous_revision,omitempty"`
	}{input.Schema, studentID, input.ExpectedOnboardingVersion, input.ExpectedPreviousRevision})
}

func DiagnosticBootstrapContextDigest(studentID string, onboardingVersion int64, binding DiagnosticBootstrapBinding) (string, error) {
	if !canonicalUUID(studentID) || onboardingVersion < 1 {
		return "", ErrValidation
	}
	binding, err := NormalizeDiagnosticBootstrapBinding(binding)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	return diagnosticJSONDigest(struct {
		PolicyVersion     string `json:"bootstrap_policy_version"`
		StudentID         string `json:"student_id"`
		OnboardingVersion int64  `json:"onboarding_version"`
		GoalCode          string `json:"goal_code"`
		DirectionCode     string `json:"direction_code"`
		CourseID          string `json:"course_id"`
		BindingRevision   int64  `json:"binding_revision"`
		BindingDigest     string `json:"binding_digest"`
	}{DiagnosticBootstrapPolicyV1, studentID, onboardingVersion, binding.GoalCode, binding.DirectionCode, binding.CourseID, binding.BindingRevision, binding.BindingDigest})
}
